items.title: Christmas cheer, but caution remains: Exporters welcome US tariff relief, keep diversification plans
items.summary: US President Donald Trump’s decision to waive proposed tariffs of up to 100% on buyers of Russian oil has eased uncertainty for Indian exporters ahead of the crucial Christmas shipping season. However, businesses across textiles, gems and jewellery, and human hair products say they will continue diversifying export markets after last year’s tariff turmoil, even as the US remains a key destination for Indian goods.

items.title: India notifies first tariff cuts under New Zealand FTA
items.summary: India will implement duty concessions for certain imports from New Zealand starting October 20, under a new FTA. The concessions include zero basic customs duty for sheep meat and specific rates for fish and wine. Additionally, provisions have been made for manuka honey and kiwi fruit imports with varying duties. Sensitive categories like dairy products are excluded from this trade liberalization agreement.

items.summary: Apple’s Tim Cook leads a study of 10 departing CEOs with an estimated $950 million in cumulative reported compensation over 15 years. Disney’s Bob Iger and Activision Blizzard’s Bobby Kotick rank next, according to research by trading firm Atmos.

items.title: Renault India CEO sees hybrids, CNG making up 50% of sales in 2-3 years; eyes 3-5% market share by 2030
items.summary: Renault India expects hybrids and CNG vehicles to account for up to 50% of sales in 2-3 years, CEO Stephane Deblaise told PTI. The automaker is pitching hybrids as an alternative to diesel and aims for 3-5% market share by 2030.

items.title: PepsiCo India wants 90–100% of its drinks portfolio to be zero-sugar or mid-calorie: What is driving the change?
items.summary: PepsiCo India aims to make 90–100% of its beverage portfolio zero-sugar or mid-calorie over time, while expanding healthier snack options. The shift comes amid changing consumer preferences and growing scrutiny of food labelling and nutrition claims in India.

items.title: Central Bank of India Q2 profit rises 21% as loans grow 30%
items.summary: Central Bank of India reported a 21% rise in September 2026 quarterly net profit to Rs 1,469 crore, supported by 26% net interest income growth and 30% loan expansion. Asset quality improved, with net NPA declining to 0.31%, while operating efficiency strengthened.

items.title: Rising borrowing costs signal funding risks for global AI expansion: Jefferies report
items.summary: As the financial markets grapple with emerging pressures, substantial investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure are evident. Companies like Oracle and CoreWeave are facing heightened credit risk, indicating struggles with borrowing amidst rising financing costs. Investors need to keep a close eye on credit spreads to gauge the viability of AI project funding.
